method: Twenty local synthetic screen fixtures rendered in Chromium at 960 by 540. Real bundled plugin HTTP requests through installed CLI Haiku. Regex checks validate required facts, followed by author review. Sequential warm local session, no baseline or human speed claim. These results do not measure arbitrary screen accuracy.
